services.name: Weekly pool cleaning
services.blurb: Skim, brush, vacuum, baskets and a full water test, on the same weekday every week.

services.name: Chemical balance
services.blurb: Readings taken and balanced at every stop, with the numbers sent to your phone.

services.name: Cloudy and algae cleanup
services.blurb: Storm-clouded or algae water brought back with brushing, shock and filter cleaning.

services.name: Pump and filter repair
services.blurb: Humming pumps, leaking seals and high filter pressure found, priced and fixed.

services.name: Filter cleaning
services.blurb: Cartridges pulled and washed or sand filters backwashed, so the pressure drops back down.

services.name: Heater and heat pump service
services.blurb: Heat pumps and gas heaters checked and repaired before the cool months arrive.

services.name: Screen enclosure pool care
services.blurb: Pools under a cage get the corners, ledges and screen-line debris cleaned too.

services.name: Leak detection
services.blurb: Dye tests and pressure tests to find where the water goes, before anything is dug up.

services.name: Resurfacing
services.blurb: Rough, stained or flaking plaster replaced with a new finish, start to refill.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Every Tuesday I get a text with the time Marcus came, the chlorine and pH, what he added and a photo of the water. First pool company where I know they actually showed up.
reviews.name: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: We came back from a week away in August and the water was cloudy after all the storms. They brushed, shocked and cleaned the cartridges, and it was clear by Thursday.
reviews.name: Raul C.

reviews.text: Pump was humming and not starting. Another company quoted a new pump. Tileline replaced a capacitor for a fraction of that and it has run fine for a year.
reviews.name: Steve P.

reviews.text: Our lanai collects oak leaves in every corner. They clean the ledges and the screen line too, not just the middle of the pool.
reviews.name: Donna R.

reviews.text: Losing an inch a day. They ran a dye test and found a crack at the skimmer throat in about an hour. Fixed it without breaking any deck.
reviews.name: Chris M.

reviews.text: Heat pump threw an error code every winter. They found a bad sensor, replaced it and showed me what the codes mean. Warm water by New Year.
reviews.name: Karen T.

proof.guarantee: If your water clouds up between weekly visits, we come back and fix it before your next service.

prices.note: depends on how far it went
